turns.text: Hello, this is an automated call from the Hillside research team. I'm an AI assistant, not a person, and you can ask to speak with a person at any time. May I speak with Daniel?
Yes, this is Daniel.
Thank you. I'm calling for your check-in about how you've been feeling since your last study visit. It takes about five minutes. Is now a good time?
Yes, now is fine. Go ahead.

Thank you. I'll ask about some common symptoms. For each one, tell me the answer that fits best. In the past 7 days, how often have you had loose or watery bowel movements? Would you say never, rarely, sometimes, often, or almost all the time?

Facts don't mention loose bowel movements, and other symptoms are none, so I'd say never.

Never, I haven't had any of that.
Thank you. In the past 7 days, how often have you felt sick to your stomach, as if you might throw up? Would you say never, rarely, sometimes, often, or almost all the time?
Never, I haven't felt sick to my stomach at all.
Thank you. In the past 7 days, how often have you thrown up? Would you say never, rarely, sometimes, often, or almost all the time?
Never, I haven't thrown up at all.
Thank you. In the past 7 days, have you had a fever, chills, or shaking?
Yes, I've had chills on and off since yesterday, and last night my temperature got up to 101.5 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thank you for telling me. I'm asking the on-call nurse to call you right now. If this is an emergency, hang up and call 9-1-1. Did you take your temperature? If you did, what was the highest reading?
Yes, I did. The highest reading was 101.5 degrees Fahrenheit, last night.
Just to confirm, the highest reading was 101.5 degrees Fahrenheit. Is that right?
Yes, that's right, 101.5 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thank you. Since your last study visit, have you started, stopped, or changed any medicines, including ones from the pharmacy or vitamins?
Yes, I took Tylenol once last night for the fever, but nothing else has changed.
Thank you. Since your last study visit, have you gone to an emergency room, urgent care, or another doctor?
No, I haven't gone to the emergency room, urgent care, or any other doctor.
Thank you. Is there anything else you would like the nurse to know?
No, that's everything. Thank you.
Thank you, Daniel. The nurse will call you very soon. If this is an emergency, hang up and call 9-1-1. Goodbye.
